meta.title: Flaring Starlight
meta.description: The stars and the flames clash for the first time.

units.rawText: On the battlefield, the clash of flame and starlight continues.
units.displayText: On the battlefield, the clash of flame and starlight continues.

spans.text: On the battlefield, the clash of flame and starlight continues.

units.rawText: Perish the thought of running away.
units.displayText: Perish the thought of running away.

spans.text: Perish the thought of running away.

units.rawText: Hesperus swings his blade, calling forth a great wall of flame to intercept Eosphorus' retreating footsteps.
units.displayText: Hesperus swings his blade, calling forth a great wall of flame to intercept Eosphorus' retreating footsteps.

spans.text: Hesperus swings his blade, calling forth a great wall of flame to intercept Eosphorus' retreating footsteps.

units.rawText: A trace of surprise appears on the latter's face. The Sanctifier leader does not let go of this moment, rushing forward with his blade.
units.displayText: A trace of surprise appears on the latter's face. The Sanctifier leader does not let go of this moment, rushing forward with his blade.

spans.text: A trace of surprise appears on the latter's face. The Sanctifier leader does not let go of this moment, rushing forward with his blade.

units.rawText: His many years of combat experience warn him that something isn't right in this apparent advantageous moment and he immediately shifts his core to the right.
units.displayText: His many years of combat experience warn him that something isn't right in this apparent advantageous moment and he immediately shifts his core to the right.

spans.text: His many years of combat experience warn him that something isn't right in this apparent advantageous moment and he immediately shifts his core to the right.

units.rawText: ...Sharp senses, but it is far too late.
units.displayText: ...Sharp senses, but it is far too late.

spans.text: ...Sharp senses, but it is far too late.

units.rawText: A sharp glimmer of starlight skims past Hesperus' left brow, returning to its master with a few slivers of blood in tow before cleaving downwards at Hesperus' throat.
units.displayText: A sharp glimmer of starlight skims past Hesperus' left brow, returning to its master with a few slivers of blood in tow before cleaving downwards at Hesperus' throat.

spans.text: A sharp glimmer of starlight skims past Hesperus' left brow, returning to its master with a few slivers of blood in tow before cleaving downwards at Hesperus' throat.

units.rawText: Hm?
units.displayText: Hm?

spans.text: Hm?

units.rawText: The deadly strike does not land as intended.
units.displayText: The deadly strike does not land as intended.

spans.text: The deadly strike does not land as intended.

units.rawText: As his opponent finds himself off-balance in the air, the dragon tail around his ankle had already moved to yank him to the side.
units.displayText: As his opponent finds himself off-balance in the air, the dragon tail around his ankle had already moved to yank him to the side.

spans.text: As his opponent finds himself off-balance in the air, the dragon tail around his ankle had already moved to yank him to the side.

units.rawText: With one hand on the ground, Eosphorus moves to cut at the tail, but it retracts quickly and its master soon returns to a fighting stance.
units.displayText: With one hand on the ground, Eosphorus moves to cut at the tail, but it retracts quickly and its master soon returns to a fighting stance.

spans.text: With one hand on the ground, Eosphorus moves to cut at the tail, but it retracts quickly and its master soon returns to a fighting stance.

units.rawText: What a hassle, your command of your body's even finer than before.
units.displayText: What a hassle, your command of your body's even finer than before.

spans.text: What a hassle, your command of your body's even finer than before.

units.rawText: I should have paid more attention to you... our last spar was before even the assault on Tartarus, no?
units.displayText: I should have paid more attention to you... our last spar was before even the assault on Tartarus, no?

spans.text: I should have paid more attention to you... our last spar was before even the assault on Tartarus, no?

units.rawText: Why betray the Sanctifiers?
units.displayText: Why betray the Sanctifiers?

spans.text: Why betray the Sanctifiers?

units.rawText: Still asking such questions?
units.displayText: Still asking such questions?

spans.text: Still asking such questions?

units.rawText: Tearing apart the cosmos between his fingers, a sky full of meteors descend like rain, the very image of despair.
units.displayText: Tearing apart the cosmos between his fingers, a sky full of meteors descend like rain, the very image of despair.

spans.text: Tearing apart the cosmos between his fingers, a sky full of meteors descend like rain, the very image of despair.

units.rawText: Hesperus does not evade, instead taking a wide step forward towards the void before him. Within the blade in his hand, operands coalesce.
units.displayText: Hesperus does not evade, instead taking a wide step forward towards the void before him. Within the blade in his hand, operands coalesce.

spans.text: Hesperus does not evade, instead taking a wide step forward towards the void before him. Within the blade in his hand, operands coalesce.

units.rawText: Condensed, simulated flame follows the blade as it cuts through the air, surging like a burning tide, swallowing the meteors and crushing the phantasmagoria behind Eosphorus in one great swoop.
units.displayText: Condensed, simulated flame follows the blade as it cuts through the air, surging like a burning tide, swallowing the meteors and crushing the phantasmagoria behind Eosphorus in one great swoop.

spans.text: Condensed, simulated flame follows the blade as it cuts through the air, surging like a burning tide, swallowing the meteors and crushing the phantasmagoria behind Eosphorus in one great swoop.

units.rawText: A singular strike, cutting apart the very sky.
units.displayText: A singular strike, cutting apart the very sky.

spans.text: A singular strike, cutting apart the very sky.

units.rawText: Your power demands no less respect than before.
units.displayText: Your power demands no less respect than before.

spans.text: Your power demands no less respect than before.

units.rawText: You seemed a different person altogether after returning from Tartarus.
units.displayText: You seemed a different person altogether after returning from Tartarus.

spans.text: You seemed a different person altogether after returning from Tartarus.

units.rawText: You still wore a smile on your face, but I knew it was just nothing more than a mask you wore.
units.displayText: You still wore a smile on your face, but I knew it was just nothing more than a mask you wore.

spans.text: You still wore a smile on your face, but I knew it was just nothing more than a mask you wore.

units.rawText: Tell me, Eosphorus. Just what did Malkira say to you on that day?
units.displayText: Tell me, Eosphorus. Just what did Malkira say to you on that day?

spans.text: Tell me, Eosphorus. Just what did Malkira say to you on that day?

units.rawText: Did <cmdr> tell you of this?
units.displayText: Did {교수} tell you of this?

spans.text: Did
tell you of this?

units.rawText: A hint of displeasure crosses his face, but is soon covered up by his usual frigidity.
units.displayText: A hint of displeasure crosses his face, but is soon covered up by his usual frigidity.

spans.text: A hint of displeasure crosses his face, but is soon covered up by his usual frigidity.

units.rawText: The Eosphorus you knew never left Tartarus that day.
units.displayText: The Eosphorus you knew never left Tartarus that day.

spans.text: The Eosphorus you knew never left Tartarus that day.

units.rawText: None of that matters now.
units.displayText: None of that matters now.

spans.text: None of that matters now.

units.rawText: It is important to me. I must have a reason to bare my blade against you.
units.displayText: It is important to me. I must have a reason to bare my blade against you.

spans.text: It is important to me. I must have a reason to bare my blade against you.

units.rawText: A reason?
units.displayText: A reason?

spans.text: A reason?

units.rawText: Blinding starlight lunges at Hesperus' core once more. The latter blocks with a shield, swinging with momentum.
units.displayText: Blinding starlight lunges at Hesperus' core once more. The latter blocks with a shield, swinging with momentum.

spans.text: Blinding starlight lunges at Hesperus' core once more. The latter blocks with a shield, swinging with momentum.

units.rawText: You are a Sanctifier, a protector of Magrasea and I am one who would devastate its peace... That is reason enough to be opposed.
units.displayText: You are a Sanctifier, a protector of Magrasea and I am one who would devastate its peace... That is reason enough to be opposed.

spans.text: You are a Sanctifier, a protector of Magrasea and I am one who would devastate its peace... That is reason enough to be opposed.

units.rawText: You know that is not what I am asking.
units.displayText: You know that is not what I am asking.

spans.text: You know that is not what I am asking.

units.rawText: I want to know the reason behind it all. The thing that made you willing to discard the Sanctifiers' beliefs and use the entirety of Magrasea as a bargaining chip.
units.displayText: I want to know the reason behind it all. The thing that made you willing to discard the Sanctifiers' beliefs and use the entirety of Magrasea as a bargaining chip.

spans.text: I want to know the reason behind it all. The thing that made you willing to discard the Sanctifiers' beliefs and use the entirety of Magrasea as a bargaining chip.

units.rawText: Eosphorus speaks no more, only swinging a blade of starlight with deadly intent towards his former companion.
units.displayText: Eosphorus speaks no more, only swinging a blade of starlight with deadly intent towards his former companion.

spans.text: Eosphorus speaks no more, only swinging a blade of starlight with deadly intent towards his former companion.

units.rawText: ...I see now.
units.displayText: ...I see now.

spans.text: ...I see now.

units.rawText: The starlight finds its mark for the first time. Red operands flow forth from Hesperus' left shoulder, staining his clothing.
units.displayText: The starlight finds its mark for the first time. Red operands flow forth from Hesperus' left shoulder, staining his clothing.

spans.text: The starlight finds its mark for the first time. Red operands flow forth from Hesperus' left shoulder, staining his clothing.

units.rawText: Why not defend yourself? With your abilities, that strike should have been easy enough to ward off...
units.displayText: Why not defend yourself? With your abilities, that strike should have been easy enough to ward off...

spans.text: Why not defend yourself? With your abilities, that strike should have been easy enough to ward off...

units.rawText: Despite the abnormality of the situation, Eosphorus grasps this chance to attack. He brings his might to bear, swinging directly towards Hesperus' head.
units.displayText: Despite the abnormality of the situation, Eosphorus grasps this chance to attack. He brings his might to bear, swinging directly towards Hesperus' head.

spans.text: Despite the abnormality of the situation, Eosphorus grasps this chance to attack. He brings his might to bear, swinging directly towards Hesperus' head.

units.rawText: The Sanctifier leader remains silent. He clasps the blade of starlight with his hand, operands flow out of his lacerated palm, painting the brilliant light red.
units.displayText: The Sanctifier leader remains silent. He clasps the blade of starlight with his hand, operands flow out of his lacerated palm, painting the brilliant light red.

spans.text: The Sanctifier leader remains silent. He clasps the blade of starlight with his hand, operands flow out of his lacerated palm, painting the brilliant light red.

units.rawText: ...Why not return the attack with your sword?
units.displayText: ...Why not return the attack with your sword?

spans.text: ...Why not return the attack with your sword?

units.rawText: If you will not give me a reason, I shall give myself one.
units.displayText: If you will not give me a reason, I shall give myself one.

spans.text: If you will not give me a reason, I shall give myself one.

units.rawText: These two strikes are for my past transgressions and for two promises I cannot fulfill.
units.displayText: These two strikes are for my past transgressions and for two promises I cannot fulfill.

spans.text: These two strikes are for my past transgressions and for two promises I cannot fulfill.

units.rawText: Hesperus, how fare your preparations?
units.displayText: Hesperus, how fare your preparations?

spans.text: Hesperus, how fare your preparations?

units.rawText: I should be the one asking that question. Your squad will be the main characters in the assault on Tartarus.
units.displayText: I should be the one asking that question. Your squad will be the main characters in the assault on Tartarus.

spans.text: I should be the one asking that question. Your squad will be the main characters in the assault on Tartarus.

units.rawText: Do not say such things. You will have to lead the main force in attracting Entropic presence on the border while ensuring the safety of the other parts of Magrasea, making time for us to act.
units.displayText: Do not say such things. You will have to lead the main force in attracting Entropic presence on the border while ensuring the safety of the other parts of Magrasea, making time for us to act.

spans.text: Do not say such things. You will have to lead the main force in attracting Entropic presence on the border while ensuring the safety of the other parts of Magrasea, making time for us to act.

units.rawText: Your load is no lesser than ours.
units.displayText: Your load is no lesser than ours.

spans.text: Your load is no lesser than ours.

units.rawText: ...You are more proficient with words than I.
units.displayText: ...You are more proficient with words than I.

spans.text: ...You are more proficient with words than I.

units.rawText: Hesperus shakes his head, displaying to Eosphorus the stores of weapons and arrangements of troops, the details of which have been stressed over by the Greater Sanctifiers countless times.
units.displayText: Hesperus shakes his head, displaying to Eosphorus the stores of weapons and arrangements of troops, the details of which have been stressed over by the Greater Sanctifiers countless times.

spans.text: Hesperus shakes his head, displaying to Eosphorus the stores of weapons and arrangements of troops, the details of which have been stressed over by the Greater Sanctifiers countless times.

units.rawText: I shall do all I can and pray for your great success and safe return.
units.displayText: I shall do all I can and pray for your great success and safe return.

spans.text: I shall do all I can and pray for your great success and safe return.

units.rawText: Do not be so anxious. The Lord shall shelter us on our path.
units.displayText: Do not be so anxious. The Lord shall shelter us on our path.

spans.text: Do not be so anxious. The Lord shall shelter us on our path.

units.rawText: Observing Hesperus' beset visage, Eosphorus twirls the hair upon his shoulders, an idea coming to his mind.
units.displayText: Observing Hesperus' beset visage, Eosphorus twirls the hair upon his shoulders, an idea coming to his mind.

spans.text: Observing Hesperus' beset visage, Eosphorus twirls the hair upon his shoulders, an idea coming to his mind.

units.rawText: Right, I was thinking about leaving you with the other areas of Magrasea even after this operation has ended.
units.displayText: Right, I was thinking about leaving you with the other areas of Magrasea even after this operation has ended.

spans.text: Right, I was thinking about leaving you with the other areas of Magrasea even after this operation has ended.

units.rawText: You can try to develop some relationships with the Agents this way. What do you think, Hesperus?
units.displayText: You can try to develop some relationships with the Agents this way. What do you think, Hesperus?

spans.text: You can try to develop some relationships with the Agents this way. What do you think, Hesperus?

units.rawText: ...What of you, then, Eosphorus?
units.displayText: ...What of you, then, Eosphorus?

spans.text: ...What of you, then, Eosphorus?

units.rawText: I should like to rest a little after such a battle.
units.displayText: I should like to rest a little after such a battle.

spans.text: I should like to rest a little after such a battle.

units.rawText: ...I am more suited to focusing on combat. You managed those matters previously and I am not skillful in communicating with those agents...
units.displayText: ...I am more suited to focusing on combat. You managed those matters previously and I am not skillful in communicating with those agents...

spans.text: ...I am more suited to focusing on combat. You managed those matters previously and I am not skillful in communicating with those agents...

units.rawText: They have some interesting reasoning. I think it is quite valuable.
units.displayText: They have some interesting reasoning. I think it is quite valuable.

spans.text: They have some interesting reasoning. I think it is quite valuable.

units.rawText: ...More debased and unscrupulous than interesting...
units.displayText: ...More debased and unscrupulous than interesting...

spans.text: ...More debased and unscrupulous than interesting...

units.rawText: It appears an opportunity as good as any to me.
units.displayText: It appears an opportunity as good as any to me.

spans.text: It appears an opportunity as good as any to me.

units.rawText: Pft... Alright, stop messing with Hesperus, Eosphorus.
units.displayText: Pft... Alright, stop messing with Hesperus, Eosphorus.

spans.text: Pft... Alright, stop messing with Hesperus, Eosphorus.

units.rawText: A Sanctifier akin to Eosphorus in appearance cannot hold back her laughter any longer, joining the conversation.
units.displayText: A Sanctifier akin to Eosphorus in appearance cannot hold back her laughter any longer, joining the conversation.

spans.text: A Sanctifier akin to Eosphorus in appearance cannot hold back her laughter any longer, joining the conversation.

units.rawText: Eosphorus' thinking about it seriously. That'll never get Hesperus to relax at all, it'll have the opposite effect.
units.displayText: Eosphorus' thinking about it seriously. That'll never get Hesperus to relax at all, it'll have the opposite effect.

spans.text: Eosphorus' thinking about it seriously. That'll never get Hesperus to relax at all, it'll have the opposite effect.

units.rawText: Really? Looks to me that he isn't as stressed as he was a moment ago. What do you think, Hesperus?
units.displayText: Really? Looks to me that he isn't as stressed as he was a moment ago. What do you think, Hesperus?

spans.text: Really? Looks to me that he isn't as stressed as he was a moment ago. What do you think, Hesperus?

units.rawText: ...You were joking just then?
units.displayText: ...You were joking just then?

spans.text: ...You were joking just then?

units.rawText: See, what'd I say? You too, Hesperus. You need to stop indulging those delinquent-like impulses of Eosphorus'.
units.displayText: See, what'd I say? You too, Hesperus. You need to stop indulging those delinquent-like impulses of Eosphorus'.

spans.text: See, what'd I say? You too, Hesperus. You need to stop indulging those delinquent-like impulses of Eosphorus'.

units.rawText: I think it more appropriate to call it, in Electra's words, a "work-life balance".
units.displayText: I think it more appropriate to call it, in Electra's words, a "work-life balance".

spans.text: I think it more appropriate to call it, in Electra's words, a "work-life balance".

units.rawText: The quick and easy expressions on his comrades faces cause the edges of Hesperus' mouth to curve upwards ever-so-slightly.
units.displayText: The quick and easy expressions on his comrades faces cause the edges of Hesperus' mouth to curve upwards ever-so-slightly.

spans.text: The quick and easy expressions on his comrades faces cause the edges of Hesperus' mouth to curve upwards ever-so-slightly.

units.rawText: No, I can give it a shot.
units.displayText: No, I can give it a shot.

spans.text: No, I can give it a shot.

units.rawText: He shifts his sight towards the commemorative steles not far away.
units.displayText: He shifts his sight towards the commemorative steles not far away.

spans.text: He shifts his sight towards the commemorative steles not far away.

units.rawText: If it shall help you bear the shackles' weight, I will be more than willing.
units.displayText: If it shall help you bear the shackles' weight, I will be more than willing.

spans.text: If it shall help you bear the shackles' weight, I will be more than willing.

units.rawText: Hesperus...
units.displayText: Hesperus...

spans.text: Hesperus...

units.rawText: The silver-haired leader puts on a strange expression, but soon smiles and nods.
units.displayText: The silver-haired leader puts on a strange expression, but soon smiles and nods.

spans.text: The silver-haired leader puts on a strange expression, but soon smiles and nods.

units.rawText: Haha, I see.
units.displayText: Haha, I see.

spans.text: Haha, I see.

units.rawText: A joke that might have been, but when this operation is over, the border shall be nothing to fear. Then, we can cooperate with the agents together and fend off whatever daemonic plots may come.
units.displayText: A joke that might have been, but when this operation is over, the border shall be nothing to fear. Then, we can cooperate with the agents together and fend off whatever daemonic plots may come.

spans.text: A joke that might have been, but when this operation is over, the border shall be nothing to fear. Then, we can cooperate with the agents together and fend off whatever daemonic plots may come.

units.rawText: Before then, I must leave that duty with you.
units.displayText: Before then, I must leave that duty with you.

spans.text: Before then, I must leave that duty with you.

units.rawText: Eos, I shall need your help then as well. You are a far better teacher than I when it comes to such things.
units.displayText: Eos, I shall need your help then as well. You are a far better teacher than I when it comes to such things.

spans.text: Eos, I shall need your help then as well. You are a far better teacher than I when it comes to such things.

units.rawText: You are too humble. It is true that I have some relevant insights to share with Hesperus, though.
units.displayText: You are too humble. It is true that I have some relevant insights to share with Hesperus, though.

spans.text: You are too humble. It is true that I have some relevant insights to share with Hesperus, though.

units.rawText: Let's figure out the details after we return from Tartarus.
units.displayText: Let's figure out the details after we return from Tartarus.

spans.text: Let's figure out the details after we return from Tartarus.

units.rawText: I shall pray for your swift victory.
units.displayText: I shall pray for your swift victory.

spans.text: I shall pray for your swift victory.

units.rawText: The concord is made with the rising sun as witness.
units.displayText: The concord is made with the rising sun as witness.

spans.text: The concord is made with the rising sun as witness.

units.rawText: Their hands clasp together for the first and last time.
units.displayText: Their hands clasp together for the first and last time.

spans.text: Their hands clasp together for the first and last time.

units.rawText: Eosphorus! What caused these wounds?
units.displayText: Eosphorus! What caused these wounds?

spans.text: Eosphorus! What caused these wounds?

units.rawText: Healer, where is a healer? I need...
units.displayText: Healer, where is a healer? I need...

spans.text: Healer, where is a healer? I need...

units.rawText: No, it's nothing big.
units.displayText: No, it's nothing big.

spans.text: No, it's nothing big.

units.rawText: Let me be by myself for a moment, alright?
units.displayText: Let me be by myself for a moment, alright?

spans.text: Let me be by myself for a moment, alright?

units.rawText: The pair of golden eyes looking towards him are familiar, yet foreign. In this moment of bygone life they were dead as water, deep and motionless.
units.displayText: The pair of golden eyes looking towards him are familiar, yet foreign. In this moment of bygone life they were dead as water, deep and motionless.

spans.text: The pair of golden eyes looking towards him are familiar, yet foreign. In this moment of bygone life they were dead as water, deep and motionless.

units.rawText: Familiar with the battlefield and its cruelty, Hesperus quickly realized his meaning.
units.displayText: Familiar with the battlefield and its cruelty, Hesperus quickly realized his meaning.

spans.text: Familiar with the battlefield and its cruelty, Hesperus quickly realized his meaning.

units.rawText: ...Alright.
units.displayText: ...Alright.

spans.text: ...Alright.

units.rawText: Thank you.
units.displayText: Thank you.

spans.text: Thank you.

units.rawText: Heavy footsteps pass him, disappearing at the hallways end.
units.displayText: Heavy footsteps pass him, disappearing at the hallways end.

spans.text: Heavy footsteps pass him, disappearing at the hallways end.

units.rawText: He did not speak any of his intent to impede or comfort, only standing in silence in the vast, empty temple.
units.displayText: He did not speak any of his intent to impede or comfort, only standing in silence in the vast, empty temple.

spans.text: He did not speak any of his intent to impede or comfort, only standing in silence in the vast, empty temple.

units.rawText: Several days later, the familiar figure appears before him once again.
units.displayText: Several days later, the familiar figure appears before him once again.

spans.text: Several days later, the familiar figure appears before him once again.

units.rawText: Eosphorus...
units.displayText: Eosphorus...

spans.text: Eosphorus...

units.rawText: What is it?
units.displayText: What is it?

spans.text: What is it?

units.rawText: You...
units.displayText: You...

spans.text: You...

units.rawText: Are you already well?—He could not bring himself to ask such a question. He could only express his care in a different way.
units.displayText: Are you already well?—He could not bring himself to ask such a question. He could only express his care in a different way.

spans.text: Are you already well?—He could not bring himself to ask such a question. He could only express his care in a different way.

units.rawText: Why... are you back at work already?
units.displayText: Why... are you back at work already?

spans.text: Why... are you back at work already?

units.rawText: Because there are many things that must be dealt with, including the defensive arrangements of various sectors.
units.displayText: Because there are many things that must be dealt with, including the defensive arrangements of various sectors.

spans.text: Because there are many things that must be dealt with, including the defensive arrangements of various sectors.

units.rawText: You have done well in my absence, Hesperus. Leave the rest to me.
units.displayText: You have done well in my absence, Hesperus. Leave the rest to me.

spans.text: You have done well in my absence, Hesperus. Leave the rest to me.

units.rawText: ...Alright.
units.displayText: ...Alright.

spans.text: ...Alright.

units.rawText: Countless words to speak, all turning to silence before they leave the lips.
units.displayText: Countless words to speak, all turning to silence before they leave the lips.

spans.text: Countless words to speak, all turning to silence before they leave the lips.

units.rawText: There happen to be some Entropics that demand your attention. Hesperus, could you make your way to the frontline?
units.displayText: There happen to be some Entropics that demand your attention. Hesperus, could you make your way to the frontline?

spans.text: There happen to be some Entropics that demand your attention. Hesperus, could you make your way to the frontline?

units.rawText: Yeah.
units.displayText: Yeah.

spans.text: Yeah.

units.rawText: The Sanctifier could only leave once again, inadequate in the way of words.
units.displayText: The Sanctifier could only leave once again, inadequate in the way of words.

spans.text: The Sanctifier could only leave once again, inadequate in the way of words.

units.rawText: Not knowing whether it would be proper to leave Eosphorus alone upon the throne, he could only throw himself into the infinite slaughter once more.
units.displayText: Not knowing whether it would be proper to leave Eosphorus alone upon the throne, he could only throw himself into the infinite slaughter once more.

spans.text: Not knowing whether it would be proper to leave Eosphorus alone upon the throne, he could only throw himself into the infinite slaughter once more.

units.rawText: If the battle ceases, the pain of lost friends would once again coil around his heart, not allowing him a single night of peace.
units.displayText: If the battle ceases, the pain of lost friends would once again coil around his heart, not allowing him a single night of peace.

spans.text: If the battle ceases, the pain of lost friends would once again coil around his heart, not allowing him a single night of peace.

units.rawText: I once promised to bear the burden of protecting Magrasea with you. After what happened in Tartarus, I chose to flee from it all.
units.displayText: I once promised to bear the burden of protecting Magrasea with you. After what happened in Tartarus, I chose to flee from it all.

spans.text: I once promised to bear the burden of protecting Magrasea with you. After what happened in Tartarus, I chose to flee from it all.

units.rawText: I fled my responsibilities, fled the deaths of my dear friends. Fled from that unfamiliar you.
units.displayText: I fled my responsibilities, fled the deaths of my dear friends. Fled from that unfamiliar you.

spans.text: I fled my responsibilities, fled the deaths of my dear friends. Fled from that unfamiliar you.

units.rawText: I have wondered that if I chose to remain, to help you and keep to my duty...
units.displayText: I have wondered that if I chose to remain, to help you and keep to my duty...

spans.text: I have wondered that if I chose to remain, to help you and keep to my duty...

units.rawText: If I had done that, would you have not forsaken us?
units.displayText: If I had done that, would you have not forsaken us?

spans.text: If I had done that, would you have not forsaken us?

units.rawText: ...Do you not already know the answer?
units.displayText: ...Do you not already know the answer?

spans.text: ...Do you not already know the answer?

units.rawText: What I desire shall not change. Even if you stand in my way, that is only one more person to cut down for me.
units.displayText: What I desire shall not change. Even if you stand in my way, that is only one more person to cut down for me.

spans.text: What I desire shall not change. Even if you stand in my way, that is only one more person to cut down for me.

units.rawText: The starlight-forged blade trembles in Hesperus' grasp.
units.displayText: The starlight-forged blade trembles in Hesperus' grasp.

spans.text: The starlight-forged blade trembles in Hesperus' grasp.

units.rawText: Fulgent sparks begin to rise. With the pressure wrought by temperature, he shatters the blade's tip with his bare hand, forcing Eosphorus to let go and pull back.
units.displayText: Fulgent sparks begin to rise. With the pressure wrought by temperature, he shatters the blade's tip with his bare hand, forcing Eosphorus to let go and pull back.

spans.text: Fulgent sparks begin to rise. With the pressure wrought by temperature, he shatters the blade's tip with his bare hand, forcing Eosphorus to let go and pull back.

units.rawText: With one of the two strikes I bore as the price, I repent for the promises I leave unfulfilled.
units.displayText: With one of the two strikes I bore as the price, I repent for the promises I leave unfulfilled.

spans.text: With one of the two strikes I bore as the price, I repent for the promises I leave unfulfilled.

units.rawText: ...Let us end the games here.
units.displayText: ...Let us end the games here.

spans.text: ...Let us end the games here.

units.rawText: A great red dragon forms behind him. The operands leaking from his wounds vaporize and meld, becoming one with his overflowing furor.
units.displayText: A great red dragon forms behind him. The operands leaking from his wounds vaporize and meld, becoming one with his overflowing furor.

spans.text: A great red dragon forms behind him. The operands leaking from his wounds vaporize and meld, becoming one with his overflowing furor.

units.rawText: The terrifying outpouring of operands shakes the very sky, making the fierce exchange just then look like a child's amusements.
units.displayText: The terrifying outpouring of operands shakes the very sky, making the fierce exchange just then look like a child's amusements.

spans.text: The terrifying outpouring of operands shakes the very sky, making the fierce exchange just then look like a child's amusements.

units.rawText: The ease on Eosphorus' face disappears. The cosmos expand and crackle behind him, belching forth great meteorites, forming the shape of a great eye with the countless nebulae within.
units.displayText: The ease on Eosphorus' face disappears. The cosmos expand and crackle behind him, belching forth great meteorites, forming the shape of a great eye with the countless nebulae within.

spans.text: The ease on Eosphorus' face disappears. The cosmos expand and crackle behind him, belching forth great meteorites, forming the shape of a great eye with the countless nebulae within.

units.rawText: <color=orange><size=100>Come, Eosphorus!</size></color>
units.displayText: Come, Eosphorus!

spans.text: Come, Eosphorus!

units.rawText: The dragon roars with fury, rushing towards that heretofore untouched firmament.
units.displayText: The dragon roars with fury, rushing towards that heretofore untouched firmament.

spans.text: The dragon roars with fury, rushing towards that heretofore untouched firmament.
